summary: Replenishment is advisory by default. Every recommendation pins an immutable input snapshot digest and algorithm version, and no recommendation can auto-send a purchase order.

impacts.evidence: Every command/store boundary requires canonical organization/workspace scope and PostgreSQL tables carry tenant keys.
Sensitive evidence/messages are minimized and tenant-scoped; otherwise this task adds no new PII authority.
No existing public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is changed; v1 host-side contracts are additive.
No existing canonical event payload is changed; workflow evidence remains additive.
Expand-only migration 000032_replenishment_planning.sql adds tenant-scoped durable state and preserves rolling compatibility.
Writes fail closed on invalid scope/policy and no provider credential is introduced into the domain model.
Sensitive or mass-write workflows preserve explicit approval/dry-run or advisory-only semantics where applicable.
Canonical IDs, versions, provider references, snapshots or append-only evidence preserve traceability.
Idempotency keys, immutable snapshots, append-only entries, atomic reservations or classified differences make retries deterministic.
No webhook transport or egress surface is added.
State/deadline/status data provides bounded operational signals for later Task 066/077 SLOs.
Schema is expand-only; rollback disables new writers while preserving historical rows for forward recovery.
Task 053 includes deterministic tests for its acceptance-critical safety invariant.
